question: Who set a new meet record in the men’s 5000m at the National Open Athletics Championships 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulveer Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulveer Singh** set a new meet record in the men’s 5000m at the **National Open Athletics Championships 2024**.
 
• The event is part of India’s most prestigious athletics competitions, where athletes from across the country compete at a national level.
 
• Gulveer Singh’s performance in the 5000m event stood out as he broke the previous record, showcasing his excellent endurance, speed, and training.
 
• His achievement adds to the growing list of exceptional performances by Indian athletes in middle and long-distance running events.
 
• This record-breaking performance is a testament to his hard work and dedication to athletics.
 
• The 5000m race is a highly demanding event that requires a combination of stamina, strategy, and mental strength.
 
• Gulveer Singh’s achievement not only highlights his personal capabilities but also reflects the growing standards of Indian athletics on national and international platforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the National Open Athletics Championships:**

 
 
• The National Open Athletics Championships is an annual event organized by the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)**.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious athletics events in India, where top athletes from across the country compete in various track and field disciplines.
 
• The event serves as a platform for athletes to showcase their talent and qualify for international competitions.
 
 
 
• **About Gulveer Singh:**
 
 
• Gulveer Singh is an emerging Indian athlete specializing in long-distance running events such as the 5000m and 10000m races.
 
• He has been making a mark in Indian athletics with consistent performances at national-level competitions.
 
• His record-breaking performance at the National Open Athletics Championships 2024 has solidified his position as one of the top long-distance runners in the country.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Athletes in Indian Athletics:**
 
 
• **Bahadur Singh:** A retired shot put athlete who has represented India at several international events and won numerous medals.
 
• **Amlan Borgohain:** A sprinter known for his achievements in 100m and 200m events, holding the national record in the 200m sprint.
 
• **Jinson Johnson:** A middle-distance runner specializing in 800m and 1500m events, known for his record-breaking performances and medals in international competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **5000m Event:**

 
 
• The 5000m race is a track event that consists of 12.5 laps on a standard 400m track.
 
• It demands a combination of speed, endurance, and tactical racing to succeed.
 
• Renowned athletes in this category have shown the importance of pacing and mental resilience in achieving success.
 
 
 
• **Training for Long-Distance Running:**
 
 
• Athletes in events like the 5000m undergo rigorous training focused on building aerobic capacity and speed endurance.
 
• Key components of training include interval training, long runs, hill workouts, and strength conditioning.
